The Goddess Sharva is believed to be the goddess of love, wisdom, and prosperity. The name Sharvisha is a combination of Sharva and the Sanskrit suffix isha, which means ruler or goddess. Thus, Sharvisha can be interpreted as the Goddess who rules over love, wisdom, and prosperity.
